ns2:section.sectionText: Priority for registration is given to majors who started coursework at Illinois prior to Fall 2018 and who are on track to graduate in SP21 or SU21. At this point in time, it does not appear that seats will be available for any student graduating beyond SU21. Please note: This section will have synchronous (live) sessions, to be held during the scheduled class day/time listed in Course Explorer.
